_note: The FLOATING take: the approved 2x bridge dolly + camera rotation layered on top (rx/ry/rz in degrees; probed signs: +ry pans left, +rx tilts down). The camera drifts up-right while slowly panning and tilting INTO the travel (ry -> -1.0 = pan right, rx -> -0.6 = tilt up toward Ge and the pine) with a hair of roll. Rotations are 0 at t=0 so frame zero stays the painting pixel-for-pixel. Rotation adds no parallax (same center of projection) -- it adds the keystone drift that reads as a handheld float.
